title: Inca Inference Economics Forecast (Q4)
content:
Executive summary:

This is a customer-specific before/after forecast for Inca Corp’s low-latency chat workload. Goal: quantify near-term and 12-month savings from adopting Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching profile, KV-prefix caching, mixed-precision quantization, and model-family routing). This doc contains the spreadsheet-style baseline, our assumptions, measured A/B pilot numbers, and recommended rollout plan with ROI.

Customer context:
- Company: Inca Corp (marketplace with real-time chat + search).
- Primary workload: conversational query + retrieval augmentation; average conversation length 18 turns, median user request tokens ~60, response tokens ~140.
- SLOs: p95 generation latency <= 220ms for non-long-tail requests; peak concurrency 3.2k RPS in a burst window.
- Current deployment: dedicated cluster of 8 A100-40GB nodes, running family-x-13b (fp16), custom batching at app layer, no KV caching, sparse autoscaling.

Baseline (observed, Nov–Dec):
- Monthly tokens generated: 1.1B input tokens, 2.6B output tokens (3.7B total).
- Average tokens/sec per GPU: 95 (measured steady-state for family-x-13b fp16).
- Average effective GPU utilization: 62% (lots of small requests).
- Monthly infra spend (raw infra only): $84,500 (cluster + network + storage amortized).
- Per-token cost (infra-only): $0.0000228/token.
- Customer-facing bill (including support & reserved pricing): $110,400/mo.

Key inefficiencies identified:
1) Low batching efficiency due to tight per-request SLO and no request coalescing: observed effective batching factor ~1.9.
2) No KV/prefix caching for repeated prompts (50% of conversations have repeated system/prefix patterns).
3) Model family overprovisioned for shorter queries; 40% of requests could be satisfied by a smaller 6–8B family at similar quality.
4) Full-fp16 execution even where int8 or 4-bit quantization is viable for chosen model variant.

Redwood Optimize recommendation summary (applied in pilot A/B):
- Adaptive batching policy: target batching factor 4 (config: max_batch_delay=18ms; max_batch_size tuned per-model).
- Prefix KV caching: cache up to 5 turns of high-frequency prefixes, TTL 600s, LRU eviction.
- Two-tier routing: route short queries (<80 prompt+response tokens) to family-sml-7b-q4_0, route longer queries to family-x-13b-quantized (int8).
- Quantization profile: 8-bit for 13b latency path, Q4_0 for 7b; ensure calibration set matched to Inca prompts.
- Autoscale smoothing + burst queue: preserve p95 SLOs while allowing higher batching in steady-state.

Pilot measured numbers (2-week A/B on 20% traffic):
- Measured batching factor: 3.7 average (vs 1.9 baseline).
- Effective tokens/sec per GPU: 220.
- GPU utilization: 81% steady-state.
- Reduction in infra footprint for pilot slice: 56% (relative to baseline on same throughput).
- End-to-end p95 latency: 210ms (meets SLO).
- Model quality: automated metric (ROUGE-L on held prompt set) within -0.9% vs baseline; manual review flagged negligible regression in chit-chat cases only.

Projected after-optimization (scaled to 100% traffic):
- Estimated monthly tokens: unchanged (3.7B total).
- Effective tokens/sec per GPU: 215 (conservative extrapolation from pilot).
- Required GPU fleet: 3.9 A100-equivalent nodes (rounded -> 4 nodes) vs 8 nodes baseline.
- Projected monthly infra spend (raw infra only): $36,900.
- Projected customer-facing bill: $52,600/mo.
- Absolute monthly savings: $57,800 (64.2% reduction infra-only), 52.3% reduction on billed amount.

Spreadsheet-style ROI (12 months):
- First-month implementation cost (engineer time + infra for pilot + eval): $36,000 (est. 3 engineers * 4 weeks + minor infra).
- Month 1 net (bill reduction not yet fully realized due to rollouts): conservative savings $20k.
- By month 2 full rollout expected; run-rate monthly savings $57.8k.
- Simple payback: Implementation cost / monthly savings = 0.62 months (approx 19 days).
- 12-month cumulative run-rate savings: $693,600.

Assumptions and sensitivity notes:
- Quality-sensitivity: 5% of traffic flagged as quality-critical (legal/sales transcripts) will remain pinned to family-x-13b-fp16; we accounted for this by keeping a safety margin (1 extra node for pinned traffic).
- Token growth: baseline assumes 10% QoQ growth; projections include this with autoscaling headroom and will lower realized savings slightly if growth accelerates faster than capacity adjustments.
- Cloud price volatility: A100-equivalent pricing assumed; using cheaper instance classes (L40s/4x H100) could further change the economics and was not included here.

Risk register (short):
- Quality regressions: mitigations = conservative routing, shadow testing, manual eval sets.
- Latency spikes during region failover: mitigation = fallback to fp16 family-x with CDN-level rate-limiting.
- Cache poisoning / stale KV issues: mitigation = cache TTLs, conservative invalidation on prompt changes.

Rollout plan (milestones):
- Week 0–2: finalize quantization calibration set + run dry-run in canary region.
- Week 3: deploy adaptive batching and KV cache to 25% traffic; measure p95 and quality.
- Week 4: expand to 100% with monitoring playbooks and rollback triggers.
- Week 5–8: observe, tune autoscale smoothing, and finalize cost report for finance.

Action items (owners):
- Priya: finalize quantization calibration set and run perf benchmark (Due: 2025-01-19).
- Marco: implement routing rules + canary config (JIRA-4237) (Due: 2025-01-24).
- Elena: run manual quality review and prepare Q/A checklist for customer success (Due: 2025-01-28).
- Avery: consolidate pilot analytics and deliver final savings model to Inca (Due: 2025-02-05).

Appendix (spreadsheet fragments):
Baseline fleet calculation:
- tokens_per_month = 3.7e9
- tokens_per_gpu_per_month = tokens_per_sec * 3600 * 24 * 30 = 95 * 3600 * 24 * 30 = 246,960,000 ~ 2.47e8
- gpus_needed = ceil(3.7e9 / 2.47e8) = ceil(14.98) = 15 GPUs -> mapped to 8 multi-GPU nodes (current config)

Optimized fleet calc (conservative):
- tokens_per_gpu_per_month = 215 * 3600 * 24 * 30 = 558,720,000 ~ 5.59e8
- gpus_needed = ceil(3.7e9 / 5.59e8) = ceil(6.62) = 7 GPUs -> mapped to 4 A100-nodes with multi-GPU packing

Monthly cost math (infra only):
- baseline node cost (amortized + support): $10,560/node -> 8 nodes = $84,480 (matches observed).
- optimized node cost: 4 nodes * $9,225 = $36,900 (we used a slight discount for committed packing).

Notes on measurements and reproducibility:
- Pilot used production request traces with sampling seed for quality evals; all experiments captured with tracing tags (optimize.pilot=inca-q1).
- Perf artifacts in linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize-playbooks/pull/88

Recommendation (short):
Approve immediate rollout to 100% following the Week 3 validation if p95 latency and manual quality checks remain within thresholds. Business case is strong: sub-1 month payback and >$650k estimated 12-month savings.
